name: Band Chest Press
description: Builds the chest muscles and mobilises the shoulders: with the band around your back, press your hands forward until your arms are nearly straight.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Put the band behind your back and bring the ends forward under your arms.
Lift your elbows up and out to the sides, knuckles forward.
cues: Press until your arms are nearly straight.
Harder: hold the band tighter across your back.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Elbows out
keyframes.cue: Elbows up and out to the sides, hands by your chest.

keyframes.name: Press
keyframes.cue: Push your hands forward until your arms are nearly straight.
